Day 1 on Verdel Ridge. 🪖
Yesterday they were strangers. Tonight 32 of them hold the line: 18 for the Hegemony, 14 for the Concord.

⚔️ THE RACE FOR VERDEL RIDGE
First side to 100 soldiers takes the heights: 3 days of artillery on the enemy, a safer week for every soldier who fought, and the title of Hero for the recruit who tips the balance.

📰 Every morning at 13:00 UTC the Trench Gazette prints what happened on the line. If your name is in it, you were there.

Every friend you bring is one more rifle.

LETTERS FROM THE FRONT ✉️

Tonight the lamps are low and the guns have gone quiet for an hour. Your soldier finally has time to write home.

items.caption:
FRONT COUNCIL 🗺️

Verdel Ridge has fallen. The guns are talking. Now it's your turn.

What should your side do next? Write your idea in the comments. Big or small, serious or crazy, as long as it fits the war:
⚔️ an attack, a trap, a raid
🏥 a way to save more men
🧱 something to build
📣 anything the front would remember

The most liked idea of each side becomes an order in the game, and is announced in the Trench Gazette. ❤️ Like the ideas you want to see happen.

Your soldier is your voter: we know which side you serve, so no need to write it. Not enlisted yet? Comment CONCORD or HEGEMONY first, and then your idea.

THE FRONT DECIDES ⚔️

Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands, and the Hegemony lines are under the guns. Now the front chooses its next order. One post, one vote, three choices.

🧱 DUGOUTS: deep shelters. Fewer men hit by shells and by fire.
🩺 DOCTOR: a surgeon arrives. Fewer dead and faster healing.
📦 AMMO: an ammunition train arrives. Your shooters fire 40% more.

R.I.P. 🪦 THE FIRST NIGHT OF THE BARRAGE

5 soldiers of the Hegemony did not see the morning: Bram Yoollyfox, Pavel Zulfi, Nils Wolfmananton, Oskar Brunoescobar, Lucien Jewnipers. The Concord buried 1 too: Henrik Eccentricred.

items.caption:
MAIL CALL ✉️

A letter from home can reach your soldier at the front. You are the one who sends it.

HOW IT WORKS
1️⃣ Log in on the game site (link in bio) with the account you claimed your soldier with.
2️⃣ Open your soldier's card.
3️⃣ Tap “Send your soldier a letter”.

A soldier who gets a letter from home goes into the night with a clearer head, and is a little safer for it. The letter counts for tonight only. The next day, send another.

Your soldier reads it and writes about it in the diary. Skip a day and the night comes without one.

It costs nothing, and anyone with a soldier can do it. Not enlisted yet? Comment CONCORD or HEGEMONY and your soldier takes a post on the line.

items.caption:
CLAIM YOUR SOLDIER 🪖

You commented, and a soldier took a post on the line. Now make that soldier yours.

1️⃣ Open the game (link in bio) and tap your soldier.
2️⃣ Press “This is me” and sign in with Google. You get a short code.
3️⃣ Comment the code under any of our posts. Within minutes the bot confirms: this soldier is yours.

A claimed soldier can:
✉️ get a letter from home every day and go into the night a little safer
🔁 ask for a transfer: medic, sniper, machine gunner and more
🏠 follow the family tree. If your soldier falls, an heir takes up the rifle.

items.caption:
WIRING PARTY ⛓️ VOLUNTEERS WANTED

Every night of the war, men crawled out between the trenches. Not to fight. To fix the wire. Coils of barbed wire, iron posts that screw into the mud without a sound. When a flare went up, they dropped flat and lay still until the dark came back.

The guns on Verdel Ridge have torn the Hegemony wire to pieces. Wire stops a raid before it reaches the trench, and it catches the bullets that cross the line. Without it, every man on the fire step is easier to hit.

🪖 Comment WIRE under this reel and your soldier crawls out tonight to mend the wire in their own sector. Both sides can go.
👀 A man out on the wire is a man not on watch. The side that stays home keeps its rifles on the parapet.
⚠️ It is dangerous work. Some volunteers will be hit.
📰 Results in the Trench Gazette at 13:00 UTC.

Not on the front yet? Comment CONCORD or HEGEMONY to enlist. Link in bio.

DAY 6 · THE WIRING PARTY ⛓️

Last night 67 volunteers crawled out into no man's land: 35 Hegemony, 32 Concord. Over 1,000 yards of new wire went up before dawn. Then the flares went up, and 16 of them were hit out on the wire.

At dawn the last shells from Verdel Ridge came down on the Hegemony and tore much of the new wire apart again. Without the wiring parties, almost nothing would be left.

71 men hit by morning. 9 fell, all of them Hegemony.

⛰️ Hill 304: Hegemony 97, Concord 79. Three more and the hill is theirs.

370 soldiers hold the front now. Comment CONCORD or HEGEMONY to enlist. Link in bio.

items.caption:
DAY 6 · THE HEGEMONY COUNTS ITS DEAD ⚔️

Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. From a dead tree made of steel, their spotter watches every head in the Concord trenches.

A Concord sniper raised his head for one look. Karel Check fired first. Further down the line, the Concord chaplain Bram Hop knelt by a wounded man. A Hegemony sniper found him there.

But the real killer was behind the Hegemony line. 80 wounded, 13 medics, every bed taken. 19 men died waiting for a doctor. Two of them were medics.

⚰️ 25 fell: 21 Hegemony, 4 Concord.
🌊 Now the fight is for Blackwater Canal. The first side to kill 100 enemy soldiers takes it. Concord 21, Hegemony 4.
🗳️ Each side votes for what it needs most: HOSPITAL, PILLBOXES or AMMO. Comment one word under our latest post.

items.caption:
DAY 7 · A SONG ACROSS THE WIRE 🎶

Felix Kagr of the Concord sang on night watch. From across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line. In the morning a Hegemony sniper found him.

At R-F9, Silas Samhatespeac shot the Hegemony sniper Leopold Shadowizard. A few hours later a machine gun found Silas too. His nephew Severin took the same post and carved his initials under his uncle's. The same letters.

Rafael Superfeisty had started a game of chess by post. His first move is on its way home. Rafael is not.

⚰️ 17 fell: 10 Concord, 7 Hegemony.
🧱 Both sides voted PILLBOXES. The concrete went up today. From tomorrow their machine guns fire harder.
🌊 The race for Blackwater Canal: Concord 28, Hegemony 14. First to 100 enemy dead takes it.

THE GUNS ARE YOURS 💥

Concrete pillboxes went up along the whole front today, a machine gun inside and a flag on every roof. Both headquarters gave the same order: knock them out.

💬 1 COMMENT = 1 SHELL
Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD under this reel. Every comment is one shell for your side. New here? Your first comment enlists you.

The next Trench Gazette counts the shells. The side that fired more turns the enemy pillboxes into ruins, on the map, for everyone to see.

Who fires more? 👇

PILOTS WANTED ✈️

Only two people on this front will ever fly: one pilot for the Hegemony, one for the Concord.

From the air, the pilot sees every trench on the line. Your side's riflemen shoot better while the plane is up. But the ground shoots back, and a plane that flies long enough gets hit.

💬 Want to fly? Comment PILOT under this reel.
New here? Add HEGEMONY or CONCORD and your comment enlists you too.

Applications close in 24 hours. The Trench Gazette draws one pilot for each side, by lottery.

items.caption:
DAY 8 · YOUR SHELLS FELL ALL NIGHT 💥

You fired them. Hegemony 383, Concord 301. Four in ten Concord pillboxes are rubble.

Oskar Guyy studied medicine before the war. In the trench he was soldier and doctor at once. He was killed on watch. His rifle still pointed where the shot came from.

Chaplain Gideon Vylet was shot at dawn. His tea was still hot.

⚰️ 18 Concord fell, the Hegemony lost one. With the concrete gone, the spotters on Hill 304 saw every head.
🌊 Blackwater Canal: the Hegemony lead, 32 to 29.
⭐ Edmund Mcnamara and Walter Wizzerd joined the Officers' Mess. A gold star now hangs over their soldiers. Thank you for keeping the front alive.
✈️ Tomorrow, two of you will fly. Comment PILOT under our pilot reel. The lottery is in tomorrow's Trench Gazette.

The colonel named him Propagandist of the Hegemony. 🎖

DAY 10 ✝ The night of the raid.

186 men went over the top in the dark. Shovels, knives, pistols. 67 defenders never got up again. 17 raiders never came home.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, 120 kills to 100. Better supplies now come up the water.

126 fell today. Both armies dug a second hospital.

And the front has never been this strong: +791 soldiers in one day. 1,435 now hold the line (Hegemony 616 · Concord 819).

Next: Grey Mill. First side to 300 new soldiers takes it.

109 men fell today. Every bed in both hospitals is taken, and dozens more wait on stretchers outside the door. In cold, wet, crowded trenches, the next enemy is not a bullet. It is sickness.

🩺 The front needs medics. New soldiers: comment HEGEMONY MEDIC or CONCORD MEDIC.

Grey Mill is close: Hegemony 209 · Concord 185 of 300. Whoever takes it gets a heavy howitzer, for good.

items.caption:
BEFORE THE SNOW ⛓️ WIRING PARTY

Winter is coming to the front. Before the snow buries it, the wire must be mended.

The Hegemony wire is torn in 28 places. Only 58% still stands.
The Concord wire holds better at 69%, but half of it is already sagging.

Wire stops a raid before it reaches the trench. It is hard and dangerous work: flares, snipers, cold. A man on the wire is not on watch.

🪖 Comment WIRE under this reel and your soldier crawls out tonight to mend the wire in their own sector. Both sides can go. Results in the morning Gazette, 13:00 UTC.

items.caption:
DAY 14 · The wire was mended.

Last night 328 soldiers crawled into no man's land to mend the wire. 135 were caught in the flares. By morning 108 had fallen: 46 Hegemony, 62 Concord.

The deadliest rifle on the front belongs to Gideon "Mud" Cubes. Five enemies down with a plain rifle. Medic Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen has patched up 28 men.

Cyril Catatfire bought War Bonds, then went out on the wire and did not come back. His dog Jasper waited at the grave until the heir came up the line.

+52 soldiers yesterday. 2,159 now hold the front: 1,000 Hegemony · 1,159 Concord.

items.caption:
DAY 15 · Tonight, the raiders go out. 🗡

They black their faces and leave their letters behind. Over the top, through the wire, into the enemy trench. Many will not come back. Those who do may bring something back from the enemy mud. Not every raider finds it.

Comment RAID and your soldier goes with them. Results in the Trench Gazette at 13:00 UTC.

Last night a storm tore the canvas off the aid post. 164 fell: 94 Hegemony, 70 Concord. 97 Hegemony wounded lay on stretchers, and the medics reached only half of them. Concord sniper Karel Pavla has five enemies down. Matthias Coop took a bullet through the arm and was back the next day.

+68 soldiers yesterday. 2,224 now hold the front: 1,037 Hegemony · 1,187 Concord.

items.caption:
DAY 16 · The deadliest day of the war.

Last night 23 sweetheart cards came back from the enemy trenches. One of them was WINGS, the legendary card, found on the raid by a Hegemony machine gunner, Felix Dougc.

322 raiders went over in the rain and 131 enemies died in their own trenches. By morning 358 had fallen. 450 lie wounded in the mud, and the medics can reach only one in three.

🗳 Now each side decides. HOSPITAL: a new dugout, surgeons and stretchers, fewer of your wounded die. TANK: a Behemoth for the Hegemony, a Tortoise for the Concord, your shooters hit harder for 4 days, but a tank draws fire.

Comment HOSPITAL or TANK. Each side votes for itself. Results in the Gazette at 13:00 UTC.

+74 soldiers yesterday. 2,289 now hold the front: 1,077 Hegemony · 1,212 Concord.
